Meaning in this report: A state is a represented observation. Movement is the difference between consecutive states within one sequence.
A perturbation is a condition-related displacement. Realization is how change appears in a particular output system and context.
Stable rank summarizes energy relative to the leading mode. Participation rank (PR) summarizes how broadly energy is distributed.
d95 counts modes needed for 95% energy. Top-4 is the energy fraction in the leading four modes.
Singular value decomposition; PC1 names the leading singular direction here. Gait SVD is uncentered about the zero-displacement origin.
Standard deviation; root mean square. Each refers to the scaling operation specified in the methods.
Alcohol Language Corpus; Korean language Alcohol Intoxicated Speech Detector source project.
Breath alcohol concentration / blood alcohol concentration. Gait exposure is labelled BrAC as in the source article.
